author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.11.0 — Adds high-traffic rooms: mark some rotation rooms to get their own (shorter) cycle length so they're cleaned more often than normal-traffic rooms. Room picking now sorts by how overdue each room is relative to its own cycle length (elapsed / cycle) instead of raw last-cleaned time, so higher-frequency rooms naturally surface more often across repeated cleanNextRooms() triggers without a hard-gated separate queue. Reduces to the previous oldest-first behavior when every room shares the same cycle length.
